title: Cohere Homepage 2026-09-27
outputText:
I have reconstructed the public Cohere homepage as observed on September 27, 2026 (`Cohere Homepage 2026-09-27`), faithfully capturing the authentic visual hierarchy, typography, product art direction, and section sequencing.

### Key Architectural & Design Decisions:
1. **Typography & Grid Structure**: Applied Cohere's custom editorial display weight (96px two-line `"Your AI. Your rules."` headline with zero CTA in the opening hero viewport, plus the 60px ending callout) paired with compact grotesk body copy and precise character tracking.
2. **Authentic Cohere Wordmark**: Handcrafted Cohere's brand mark featuring the dark green lowercase `cohere` letterforms and the four organic multi-colored lozenges/dots.
3. **Zone Transitions & Color Palette**:
   - **Opening & Hero**: Bright pure white with generous negative space and the high-fidelity 1200px North Agent workspace canvas set against granular dark gold/green gradients.
   - **Customer Marquee**: Industry logos including Oracle, Dell Technologies, RBC, LG CNS, Fujitsu, Bell, Asana, RWS, SAP, Salesforce, TD Bank, Ensemble, Second Front, McKinsey, Accenture, BambooHR, STC, and Carahsoft.
   - **Campaign Banner (520px)**: Two adjacent photographic halves with the dark woodland green left half (`"AI for Empowerment"`, exact paragraph, white pill CTA) and golden landscape silhouette on the right.
   - **Purpose-Built Solutions Zone**: Warm pale-stone `#f0eee9` backdrop framing the three product panels (North Platform with Financial Analysis Agent graph, Cohere Models with fine dotted grid and model family cards, and Model Vault with dedicated VPC deployment architecture).
   - **Powering Progress Across Industries**: Pure white section with the lavender-tinted live agent session card and interactive accordion list (Financial Services expanded with bullet points, plus Public Sector, Technology, and Energy & Utilities).
   - **Why Leading Teams Trust Cohere & NVIDIA Endorsement**: Customer stories for CoreWeave, Draftwise, and Fujitsu, anchored by the NVIDIA mark and Jensen Huang's exact quote.
   - **The Latest News**: 3-card editorial row featuring the Aleph Alpha transatlantic sovereign alliance, OpenText partnership, and AI rules editorial (dated Sep 14–16, 2026).
   - **Security Zone**: Deep forest-green `#152717` container displaying the 5 compliance marks: SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, CCPA, ISO 27001, and Cyber Essentials Plus.
   - **Footer & Ending Callout**: Pure white `"Ready to put AI to work?"` with dark pill CTA and dense 8-column navigation.
suggestions: Create the mobile viewport version (390px) with responsive stacked cards and accessible mobile nav
Add subtle CSS micro-interactions and smooth accordion toggling for the industry section
Generate a dedicated deep-dive page for North Platform and the Agentic Workspace
